page_title: SAL 1-3 EMP | Salernitana v Empoli 09/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+4' 1 - 3 Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Guillermo Ochoa is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 1:3.
90+4' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Alberto Cerri (Empoli) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+3' A rebound sits up nicely for Toma Basic (Salernitana), whose shot from distance is blocked by a defender.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
90' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Empoli.
90' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
89' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) commits a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. Salernitana are awarded a free kick.
88' 1 - 2 Goal! M'Baye Niang (Empoli) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Guillermo Ochoa into the bottom right corner.
88' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

86' Marco Pellegrino (Salernitana) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Maurizio Mariani blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Empoli are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
85' Shon Weissman (Salernitana) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
83' It looks like Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) saw red with that tackle. Maurizio Mariani won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
82' The free kick into the penalty area from Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is cleared.
82' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) commits a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for an infringement. Salernitana will take a free kick near the side line.
78' Substitution. Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) in, Szymon Zurkowski out.
78' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) replacing Nicolo Cambiaghi.
77' Toma Basic (Salernitana) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) coming on for Giulio Maggiore.
75' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
72' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
70' Here is a change. Alberto Cerri is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to M'Baye Niang (Empoli).
70' Substitution. Youssef Maleh will be replaced by Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli).

69' 1 - 1 Goal – 1:1! Antonio Candreva sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Shon Weissman (Salernitana) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the bottom left corner.
67' The corner from Liberato Cacace (Empoli) is hurriedly cleared.
65' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
65' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) takes the corner.

65' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Corner kick. Salernitana will have an opportunity.
64' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
64' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
63' Alberto Cerri (Empoli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Empoli can continue in their attacking effort.
63' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Empoli comes to nothing.
62' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Empoli win a corner.
61' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
59' Filippo Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Grigoris Kastanos is replaced by Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana).
59' Substitution. Jerome Boateng leaves the pitch and is replaced by Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana).
57' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
55' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) tries to find Alberto Cerri, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.

52' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed low towards the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
51' Alberto Cerri (Empoli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
49' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
47' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) sends a cross into the box, but Elia Caprile comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' A brilliant cross into the box finds Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alessandro Zanoli departs the field of play to be replaced by Junior Sambia (Salernitana).
46' The whistle blows and Maurizio Mariani starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Salernitana take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

45+1' That was a nice football moment. Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the top right corner. Elia Caprile guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! Salernitana force a corner. They send men into the box.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
44' Now Empoli have a corner.
43' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Empoli are awarded a corner kick.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alessandro Zanoli (Salernitana) was quite harsh and Maurizio Mariani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Problems for Filippo Inzaghi as Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Shon Weissman replaces him.
39' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
38' Salernitana take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

37' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Salernitana force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
37' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana).
35' Alberto Cerri (Empoli) gets in a header from close range after a lofted pass, but the effort flies just over the bar.
33' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle. Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) commits a foul after dangerous play.
33' Dangerous play by Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana). Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) is able to continue to play.
29' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle as Alberto Cerri (Empoli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
28' The free kick is delivered by Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
28' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
23' 0 - 1 OWN GOAL! Alessandro Zanoli (Salernitana) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 0:1.
22' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Maurizio Mariani had an easy-decision to make.
21' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
20' Alberto Cerri (Empoli) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just over the bar.
20' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
19' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
18' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
17' The ball is cleared after Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
16' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
14' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) makes a strong challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
12' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
9' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

9' A lofted cross from Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. Empoli will have a chance to score from a corner.
7' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
4' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) takes the corner but it's cleared.

4' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and Salernitana manage to earn a corner.
2' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Salernitana will kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will referee today's match.
